Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri October 29, 2024 1:27 pm Introduction 3RI Technologies and the esteemed E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati have teamed up to launch a complete cloud computing and DevOps training curriculum in an exciting partnership. This strategic partnership seeks to close the skills gap in the IT industry by providing advanced learning opportunities for students and working professionals. To provide excellent training, the 3RI Technologies Cloud Computing program collaborates with the E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati DevOps course, using the reputation and experience of both organizations. Preparing students for high-growth employment in the digital age, the curriculum focuses on practical skills and industry-relevant knowledge to equip them with in-demand expertise in cloud infrastructure and DevOps processes. The IIT Guwahati DevOps course offered by E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati in collaboration with 3RI Technologies equips you with high-demand skills in cloud computing and DevOps. This industry-recognized program is designed for professionals and graduates aiming to build a future-proof career. While many compare roles like MEAN Stack developers and wonder about the salary of MEAN Stack developers in India, DevOps engineers are rapidly becoming even more sought-after. This program not only boosts your skillset but also significantly enhances your earning potential. Join today to transform your career trajectory with expert mentorship and real-world projects. Why Choose the IIT Guwahati DevOps Course for Your Career? Two of the most sought-after competencies in the job market today are cloud computing and dev operations, and these domains are essential for several reasons. Cloud computing is transforming how companies handle, store, and process data. Professionals with expertise in platforms like AWS (Amazon Web Services), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) are in high demand as businesses shift more and more from traditional infrastructure to cloud-based solutions. Recent estimates indicate that cloud computing will grow worldwide to $832.1 billion by 2025, generating many work possibilities. Likewise, DevOps has emerged as the foundation for effective software development and implementation. It is a collection of procedures integrating IT operations (Ops) and software development (Dev) to produce high-quality software faster. Continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), automation, and monitoring are examples of DevOps technologies and approaches that streamline development processes, lower errors, and boost productivity. The Role of Cloud Platforms in Modern Businesses: Cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP are essential for modern enterprises to grow, develop, and stay flexible. Without significant investments in physical infrastructure, they provide scalable and reasonably priced infrastructure, enabling businesses to roll out apps and services as needed. These platforms enable companies to use big data, enhance decision-making, and improve customer experiences with data storage, analytics, AI services, and more capabilities. DevOps: Streamlining Development Processes: By fostering a collaborative culture between development and operations teams, the incorporation of DevOps methods has revolutionized software development. It improves product development’s quality, speed, and agility. DevOps allows rapid release cycles with automated testing, continuous monitoring, and feedback loops, guaranteeing that companies can promptly adjust to the market’s demands. Higher customer happiness, lower costs, and quicker innovation result from this synergy between development and operations. Overall, there has never been a greater need for expertise in DevOps and Cloud Computing, and gaining these abilities will open up many career options in the tech sector. Key Features of This Program Extensive Curriculum: Cloud architecture, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and well-known platforms like AWS, GCP, and Azure are essential topics covered in the professional cloud computing and DevOps curriculum. Additionally, the training delves deeply into monitoring and automation strategies. Practical Projects and Labs: The program provides a well-balanced combination of theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience through industry-relevant projects and lab sessions, guaranteeing that participants acquire real-world skills. Industry-Relevant credentials: To increase their reputation in the field, students will have the chance to obtain internationally renowned credentials like Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Azure Administrator, and AWS Solutions Architect. Skilled Faculty: The program guarantees quality and authenticity because knowledgeable instructors from 3RI Technologies teach it in association with the prestigious faculty of E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati. Career Support : To help participants land jobs in prestigious cloud and DevOps companies, they will receive career counselling and help to find a job. Course Modules and Structure Important subjects covered in this Cloud Computing with DevOps course include: Cloud architecture. Container management with Kubernetes and Docker. Building effective CI/CD pipelines. Becoming proficient with AWS and Azure with DevOps. Learners will become proficient in DevOps tools, including AWS, Azure, and GCP, as well as critical abilities like automation and monitoring. The course allows students to exercise their abilities in real-world situations by striking the ideal mix between theoretical knowledge and practical laboratories. By the end of the program, students will have a solid understanding of the AWS cloud computing syllabus and are prepared to succeed in DevOps and Azure cloud positions. Jenkins: With DevOps live project training , become proficient in Jenkins to automate build, test, and deployment procedures through effective CI/CD pipelines. AWS and Azure: Learn how to use popular cloud platforms like AWS and Azure. Gain expertise in cloud management, automation, and monitoring, which are necessary for taking on challenging real-world cloud computing projects. Ansible: Investigate Ansible to automate configuration and infrastructure management activities, facilitating smooth workflows and environment setups across practical DevOps initiatives. By giving students hands-on experience with cloud and DevOps environments, these tools and technologies equip students to tackle problems pertinent to the industry by giving them hands-on experience with cloud and DevOps environments. Advantages of Joining the Program Complete Skill Development: The program gives participants fundamental DevOps and Cloud Computing knowledge, preparing them for various tech-related jobs. Expert Instruction: Gain knowledge from renowned E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati faculty members, and seasoned trainers at 3RI Technologies, guaranteeing top-notch instruction and industry insights. Real-World Experience: Take part in practical DevOps and cloud computing projects that will improve your employability and give you real-world experience. Career Advancement Opportunities: Take advantage of career support services, such as aid in finding a job, to land fulfilling jobs in the quickly expanding cloud and DevOps industries. Who Should Enroll? A wide variety of people seeking to improve their abilities in the ever-changing tech sector are the target audience for the professional Cloud Computing and DevOps program . This includes: Beginners in Cloud Computing: If you are new to the sector, this cloud computing course for beginners provides a solid foundation in cloud technology and DevOps processes, making it a great way to begin your career. IT Professionals Seeking Advancement: This training will be extremely helpful to current IT professionals who want to advance into cloud roles or improve their DevOps skills. It acts as a stepping stone for individuals who want to focus on cloud computing and DevOps techniques. Developers and Software Engineers : Practical instruction in CI/CD pipelines, automation, and cloud deployment tactics would benefit software developers looking to add DevOps certification for professionals to their skill set. System Administrators: This program will give system administrators the knowledge and abilities they need to embrace cloud technologies and boost operational effectiveness through DevOps techniques. Project Managers: This training can help professionals overseeing IT projects better lead their teams by helping them comprehend how development, operations, and cloud services intersect. All things considered, this program is ideal for anyone hoping to launch a lucrative career in cloud computing and DevOps, regardless of prior experience, if you are asking who should take DevOps certification. Cloud Operations Manager Manages cloud operations, ensuring service availability and performance. $130,000 – $180,000 Increased demand for operational efficiency in cloud environments. Why Choose 3RI Technologies & E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati? Selecting the Professional Cloud Computing and DevOps Program at 3RI Technologies & E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati guarantees that you will receive excellent instruction and training from professionals in the field. The cooperation is a great option for anyone wishing to progress their careers in cloud computing and DevOps since it offers a combination of academic discipline and real-world knowledge. Through a thorough curriculum and practical projects, students acquire the abilities necessary to succeed in the area. Along with specific AWS DevOps training, this program offers one of the best DevOps certifications in Pune, giving you the skills employers seek in today’s workforce. There are five easy steps to apply for 3RI Technologies & E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati’s Professional Cloud Computing and DevOps Program: Go to the Program’s Official Page: Visit the websites of IIT Guwahati or 3RI Technologies. Look for the Professional Cloud Computing and DevOps Program section to obtain the necessary information. Complete the application form : Fill out the online application form, including your personal and educational information. This step is required for the registration of the E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati cloud computing program. Upload Required Documents: Compile and send the required paperwork, including a resume, academic credentials, and identification. Verify the requirements for documents listed on the application page. Pay the Course Fees: Review the cloud and DevOps course fees listed on the website and make the payment using the available options. For your records, retain a copy of the transaction receipt. Await Confirmation and Join Orientation: You will receive an email confirming the processing of your application after submitting it. Attend the orientation session to discover vital information about the program and how to enroll in the DevOps course successfully. Following these steps, you can easily secure your place in this exciting program! The Bottom Line In partnership with E&ICT Academy, IIT Guwahati, 3RI Technologies offers the Professional Cloud Computing & DevOps Program, which aims to give prospective cloud and DevOps workers the fundamental knowledge of AWS, Azure, and other DevOps tools. Graduates of this career-focused curriculum will thoroughly understand contemporary cloud technology and be ready to meet market demands. Signing up opens the door to many opportunities in this exciting industry and takes a big step toward developing your Job-oriented career in cloud computing and DevOps career.
